submitted.body:
An explicit bijective local antimagic labeling of the eighteen edges of M_12 induces three distinct vertex sums, with unequal sums at every adjacent pair. An odd cycle gives the matching lower bound, hence chi_la(M_12) = 3, contradicting the claimed value four for every even parameter n >= 4. The ordinary argument proves the exact value; the Lean endpoint formalizes the negation of the universal value-four conjecture.

**Result and scope:** chi_la(M_12) = 3 (Lean certifies the failure of the value 4; the matching lower bound 3 is an ordinary odd-cycle argument), refuting Lau-Shiu-Ng Conjecture 3.2 for even n >= 4; remark: chi_la(M_8) = 3 contradicts Lau-Shiu (arXiv:2203.06594, Acta Math. Hungar. 169 (2023)) Theorem 2.4

**Complete proof and verification sources:** [Three induced colours on the Mobius ladder M_12: a refutation of the Lau-Shiu-Ng even Mobius ladder local antimagic conjecture](https://mathdb.com/abs/2611.00060) · [PDF](https://mathdb.com/pdf/2611.00060v1).
